comment: The 'voices of the world' used in the promo: each is spoken once in its own language (shared by every film language) and is dubbed into the viewer's language (see promo.<lang>.json -> dubs). `order` is the priority list: the crowd takes the first 10 entries that are not the viewer's own language, the dubs the first 6 of `dubOrder`.

ja.name: 日本語
ja.style: soft, intimate, curious and slightly hesitant, like someone speaking quietly into a microphone at night
ja.text: ねえ、聞こえる？ 私の言ってること、わかる？
ja.en: Hey, can you hear me? Do you understand what I’m saying?

ko.name: 한국어
ko.style: emotional and warm, a little breathless, like a drama scene
ko.text: 정말 보고 싶었어. 왜 이렇게 늦게 왔어?
ko.en: I missed you so much. Why did you take so long?

de.name: Deutsch
de.style: calm university lecturer, clear and measured
de.text: Heute schauen wir uns an, wie neuronale Netze eigentlich lernen.
de.en: Today we’ll look at how neural networks actually learn.

es.name: Español
es.style: cheerful, energetic podcast host opening a new episode
es.text: ¡Hola a todos, y bienvenidos a un nuevo episodio!
es.en: Hello everyone, and welcome to a new episode!

ru.name: Русский
ru.text: Добрый вечер. Главные новости к этому часу.
ru.en: Good evening. Here are the top stories of the hour.

fr.name: Français
fr.style: hushed documentary narrator full of wonder
fr.text: Dans les profondeurs de l’océan, la lumière ne pénètre jamais.
fr.en: In the depths of the ocean, light never reaches.

zh.name: 中文
zh.style: excited gamer shouting with team spirit
zh.text: 兄弟们，这把我们一定能赢！
zh.en: Guys, we’re definitely winning this one!

it.name: Italiano
it.text: Oggi vi porto nel posto più bello di Roma.
it.en: Today I’m taking you to the most beautiful place in Rome.

pt.name: Português
pt.style: ecstatic football commentator shouting a goal
pt.text: E é gol! Que golaço, minha gente!
pt.en: And it’s a goal! What a goal, everyone!

tr.name: Türkçe
tr.text: Şimdi içine bir tutam tuz ekliyoruz.
tr.en: Now we add a pinch of salt.

hi.name: हिन्दी
hi.text: आज हम सीखेंगे कि इसे सिर्फ़ पाँच मिनट में कैसे बनाएँ।
hi.en: Today we’ll learn how to make this in just five minutes.

ar.name: العربية
ar.text: مرحباً بكم في حلقة جديدة من برنامجنا.
ar.en: Welcome to a new episode of our show.

pl.name: Polski
pl.en: Good morning, let’s begin today’s lecture.

nl.name: Nederlands
nl.text: Kijk eens naar de zonsondergang boven de zee.
nl.en: Look at the sunset over the sea.

narrator.style: confident, warm and clear; brisk and energetic like a modern product launch film, about 170 words per minute, with only short natural pauses between sentences and no long silences
